rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as an interaction test, fits ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment with explicit WT/vehicle reference levels, tests the genotypeKO:treatmentdrug Wald coefficient, and reports both simple effects via list contrasts rather than a one-factor model on four groups. QC is blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap with library sizes and an explicit flag-don't-drop outlier policy; the filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest cell) is minimal and justified; normalization is DESeq2 median-of-ratios inside the model; BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm/ashr shrinkage, and p-value histograms are all stated. Enrichment is well specified (fgsea on Wald stat, full list, tested-gene universe, Hallmark 2026.1 and Reactome, 15-500 window, per-contrast) though the Entrez mapping step is superfluous given symbol GMTs and Reactome is only pinned as 'current'. The report requirements name versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, and the n=4 interaction-power caveat.
